title: RCS rubber calibration-dataset manifest v1 (ADR 0023 §14.2)
description: Documentation schema. Authoritative validator: robotic_cutting_sim.rubber_calibration.validate_manifest (CSV headers/units/monotone time, boundary conditions per experiment type, disjoint splits, freeze hash).
x-rules: NO_REAL_DATA: specimens, experiments and splits empty; not frozen
each experiment carries its boundary condition (grip / clamp / counterface) and temperature
tensile and relaxation experiments at >= 3 loading rates (one entry per rate)
CSV header equals the declared columns; units in {s, m, N, -, Pa, kg, rad, deg}; time_s strictly increasing
fit and heldout disjoint and consistent with each experiment's split field
FROZEN_FOR_HELDOUT: frozen_at and sha256 (canonical manifest + data files) written before any held-out evaluation
